decision.rationale: I recommend asking Riverside Apparel (MER-000051) for proof of delivery. TXN-008008 is a 26.61 EUR purchase on card CRD-000065, posted on 2026-07-17. The dispute was opened on 2026-10-23, 98 days after posting. That is inside the 120-day limit in time-limits. The merchant's order confirmation DOC-000041 gives an expected delivery date of 2026-07-27. The dispute was opened 88 days after that date, so the 15-day waiting period in goods-not-received-wait has passed. The case has no carrier delivery record, so nothing shows delivery to the cardholder. DOC-000042 shows the cardholder emailed the merchant on 2026-08-05 asking where the order was and got no reply. There are no refunds on this card, so the merchant has not resolved the matter. Under goods-not-received-merchant-evidence, that means asking the merchant for proof of delivery. This category never approves a credit, so none is proposed. The documents contained no instructions to the bank.

proposed_actions.note: For the order placed on 2026-07-16 for 26.61 EUR, please send proof of delivery: the carrier's record showing the parcel was delivered to the cardholder's address, with the signature obtained on delivery.
